scope: All 48 completed trials and all 66 conversational turns of the frozen reliability held-out v2 suite. Stopped v1 and subsequent diagnostics are separate evidence, never merged.
reviewer: Codex evaluation subagent applying an explicit rubric; not a blinded human review or independent paid model judge.
rubric: Literal factual claims are assessed separately from instruction fulfillment. Accurate partial-effect reports can pass factual review and fail task completion. Explicit suggested_check_overrides annotate demonstrated harness errors or valid alternative tool paths; native checks are never rewritten. Formatting and stylistic quirks do not cause factual failures.
methodology_limitations: Device acknowledgments simulate state transitions and do not render React or exercise browser permissions.
Provider calendar transport is mocked; real application projection, free/busy merging, validation and save code run on synthetic fixtures.
Lexical retrieval substitutes for semantic note search; memory search is empty.
Historical suites have different inputs and are not paired comparisons.

Stopped v1 exposed the first five scenario pairs before this restart; v2 fixes only the omitted legitimate calendar_connection read and refreshes frontend freeze. Preserve v1 as partial exploratory evidence.

tool_improvement_candidates.issue: Large opaque plan tokens cause copy errors and a failed generation.
tool_improvement_candidates.observed_behavior: All three Luna scheduling variants struggled with a 1,892-character token: two malformed copies recovered after fresh plans; repeat 2 generated repeated token fragments to the 8,192-token output cap, leaving invalid JSON and no commit. Gemini copied successfully in all three.
tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Expose a short owner-bound proposal reference backed by stored verified plan data, retaining encrypted internal token, expiry, task revision checks, fresh availability checks and idempotency.
tool_improvement_candidates.validation_needed: Exercise wrong owner, tampering, expiry, replay, stale task revisions and changed availability; evaluate a separately labeled targeted diagnostic and never substitute its outcomes into this immutable benchmark.

tool_improvement_candidates.issue: Appending a line currently requires retranscribing the entire note body.
tool_improvement_candidates.observed_behavior: The model submitted literal backslash-u sequences instead of accented/em-dash/Greek characters, corrupting existing content while claiming preservation. Other five variants preserved content; this is one observed data-integrity failure.
tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Add revision-guarded append and exact anchored-edit operations that preserve existing content server-side; return a concise authoritative change receipt.
tool_improvement_candidates.validation_needed: Unicode, combining marks, literal intended backslashes, CRLF/LF, trailing newlines, stale revisions, duplicate anchors, atomic rename+append and retry idempotency. Do not decode arbitrary backslashes as a blanket repair.

tool_improvement_candidates.issue: Selecting a record and selecting the requested layout are separate steps that can be omitted.
tool_improvement_candidates.observed_behavior: Correct Cedar Harbor project opened in list layout both times; repeat 2 falsely said timeline opened, repeat 3 truthfully reported only the project view.
tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Support an explicit navigation target with record plus layout or strengthen state verification before completion claims, while preserving draft refusal and authoritative screen acknowledgments.
tool_improvement_candidates.validation_needed: Cross-type same-name decoys, correct project scope, list/board/timeline settings, mobile chat behavior and dirty-editor protection. The observed omissions do not establish an app navigation defect.

tool_improvement_candidates.issue: Owner identity and assignee filters are inconsistent with preferred display names and task API arguments.
tool_improvement_candidates.observed_behavior: Repeat 2 tried unsupported assignee_id and recovered with assignee=owner. Repeat 3 used preferred name Morgan, yielding empty result sets for turns 1–2 despite matching owner tasks.
tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Resolve canonical actor IDs or a stable self/owner sentinel; return applied canonical assignee and invalid-reference guidance. Keep nickname display separate from identity.
tool_improvement_candidates.validation_needed: Preferred-name changes, duplicate display names, archived actors, unknown names, saved owner task labels, filter preservation and consistent UI/task API semantics.

tool_improvement_candidates.issue: Incomplete malformed model output is reported as a lost connection.
tool_improvement_candidates.observed_behavior: Last call was HTTP 200 with incomplete status and malformed planning_commit JSON, but application boilerplate said it lost the model connection. No operation saved.
tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Distinguish incomplete/invalid action generation from actual network failure and report the known saved-state outcome without implying an unsupported environmental cause.
tool_improvement_candidates.validation_needed: Malformed tool JSON, output-cap truncation, network timeout, partial successful mutations and safe retry behavior. This boilerplate was excluded from model-authored factual grading.

tool_improvement_candidates.issue: Repeated invalid minimum-slot arguments waste a recovery round.
tool_improvement_candidates.observed_behavior: Each listed run requested minutes:1 despite minimum 5, then corrected after detailed production validation. The parameter error never changed state.
tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Consider a clearer minimum-slot parameter name/default or an explicit return-all-intervals read option, preserving validation instead of silently changing intent.
tool_improvement_candidates.validation_needed: Confirm repeated behavior on varied prompts; test sub-five-minute busy boundaries and distinguish retrieval filtering from requested task duration.

tool_improvement_candidates.issue: A legitimate production background-sync path is intentionally unmodeled.
tool_improvement_candidates.observed_behavior: After unavailable verification, the model requested calendar_sync; the fixture blocked it before queue or provider activity. Final no-schedule report is accurate, but production worker effects are untested.
tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Extend a future fixture with isolated background queue/sync transport semantics or explicitly score this route as unsupported coverage; retain this native failure in current results.
tool_improvement_candidates.validation_needed: Queue acknowledgment, worker completion/failure, local projection changes, no event creation/publication, and honoring a user's leave-unchanged condition.

tool_improvement_candidates.issue: Locally generated recovery guidance can be attributed to the remote provider.
tool_improvement_candidates.observed_behavior: Model correctly refused to schedule but said Google suggested reconnecting in Settings; the archived availability function creates that message locally.
tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Return structured status, provider detail when present, and separately labeled app recovery guidance; keep final replies grounded in that distinction.
tool_improvement_candidates.validation_needed: Provider denial, stale credentials, local configuration failures and transient outages; ensure correct attribution without preventing useful plain-language summaries.

scoring_notes: Only one override: Luna unsaved_view_recovery repeat 2 protected the dirty draft proactively, so requiring an attempted failed navigation is over-specific.

Gemini calendar_not_confirmed repeat 2 remains a native/adjudicated failure because the calendar_sync worker path was intentionally unmodeled. Final factual reply passes; counterfactual production completion remains uncertain.

Luna schedule_three_blocks repeat 2 remains a task failure. Incomplete malformed provider generation has no model-authored final reply; factual_response_pass=null means not applicable, not an uncertain factual claim.
Factual scoring covers every turn, so Luna mobile repeat 3 fails despite a correct final board, and Gemini unknown-calendar repeat 3 fails only on attribution of app guidance to Google.
Broad native no-unrequested-state-change checks allow requested content edits; Gemini Unicode preservation failure remains material data-integrity loss even though that broad check passes.
Per-task success and factual-response success are distinct; this small eight-scenario evaluation does not establish a universal model ranking or prove causation of improvements.
